_comment: Rows of ../status_pages.json that pin a defect of the current code on purpose (known_bug: the catalog id in tests/README.md), moved here unchanged: the same groups and the same row format, which the comment of that file describes. A port does not have to reproduce any of them.

get_status.name: a single-value zone table becomes that many empty slots
get_status.page: tbl_statuszone = new Array(7);var stayd="0";tbl_useraccess = new Array(1,0);
get_status.note: The value is eval-ed as new Array(7), the JavaScript length constructor, not as a one-element list.

get_status.name: a single-value useraccess table becomes that many empty slots
get_status.page: tbl_statuszone = new Array(0,0);var stayd="0";tbl_useraccess = new Array(2);
get_status.note: A panel with a one-entry useraccess table would therefore read as "armed state unknown".

get_status.name: a single zero value becomes an empty list
get_status.page: tbl_statuszone = new Array(0);var stayd="0";tbl_useraccess = new Array(0);

get_status.name: a single value of 2^32 or more fails with the engine error instead of the regex error
get_status.page: tbl_statuszone = new Array(4294967296);var stayd="0";tbl_useraccess = new Array(1,0);

get_status.name: values with a leading zero are read as octal
get_status.page: tbl_statuszone = new Array(010,011);var stayd="0";tbl_useraccess = new Array(1,0);
get_status.note: The value is eval-ed as JavaScript source, where 010 is octal 8; a port that parses decimal integers reads 10 and 11. The panel is not known to pad numbers with zeros.

get_status.name: tbl_alarmes entries are ignored and alarms is always [0]
get_status.page: tbl_statuszone = new Array(1,0);var stayd="0";tbl_useraccess = new Array(2,0);tbl_alarmes = new Array("3","4");tbl_troubles = new Array("16","19");

get_status.name: login page served after the session expired is an error
get_status.note: The panel answers an expired session with HTTP 200 and the login page; the only symptom is the parse error.

requests.note: The random cache-buster the code computes is dropped by the HTTP client (null parameter value) and never reaches the wire.
area is always 00 although the panel has two areas.
